answer: To resist Sybil attacks, our network anchors identity verification to a cryptographic stake burning mechanism. Each new agent node arriving at the digital wharf must burn tokens proportional to C(n) = k * n^2.5, enforcing superlinear cost scaling against an adversary deploying n identities. This imposes steep economic friction, locking away ivory collateral and expanding identity costs toward an unattainable horizon for coordinated attackers.
